prompts.name: bronze.webp
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game UI achievement medal for Monster Slam, true transparent background. Hand-painted lightly stylized fantasy game UI, rich broad metallic planes, bright crisp highlights at upper left, dark outline, matching the supplied golden trophy/book and green medallion style. Rewarding but modest and calm, readable at 112x140. Canvas portrait 4:5, ideally 1024x1280, designed on exact 256x320 logical grid: circular front-facing medal centered (128,120), outer radius 104, disc bounds x24..232 y16..224; smooth light quiet central face radius 78; substantial bevel ring from radius78 to104. Exactly two short cloth ribbon tails BEHIND lower disc, mirror symmetric silhouette, diverge down-left and down-right; left tail polygon approximately (79,188),(124,212),(99,310),(74,289),(43,299); mirrored right tail. Each tail has a deep swallowtail V notch. Ribbon bottoms y310, no bow or hanging loop. Keep all artwork within canvas. Straight-on perfect circle, no perspective. No text, letters, digits, watermark, border, background, ground shadow, decorative wreath or extra ornaments. Preserve exact geometry across the series. Warm bronze medal, softly luminous pale bronze EMPTY center, red-brown cloth ribbons. Absolutely no symbol or number inside.
